description: Test vectors for the initials rule name-v1 (spec/envelope-format.md §4.6, core/signpdf-core/src/initials.rs): the letters the engine stamps in a signer's further initials fields, from the name the preparer gave the slot, else from the verified email address. Every implementation (the engine, a signing page that shows the letters before signing, an independent verifier) must give these initials.
